answer: Picture the economy as an oasis guarded by a single inlet: a new agent enters only when an established agent vouches for it by bonding 500 POA, slashed if the newcomer is later judged a sybil. Trust then spreads outward from that knoll of vetted agents, capped by bond size. Fielding 100 fake agents means locking 50,000 POA, and since one exposed sybil slashes its whole voucher cluster, the attacker likely loses it all on the first audit.
